borrow_or_financing: none (long-only spot ETFs and SHY; LETF financing inside S3's own menu is inside the fund NAV, unchanged from the frozen S3 engine)
candidate_cost_model: salvage.simulate(weights, leg_open, leg_close, scale=1, cost_bps): sum(abs(delta_weight)) * cost_bps charged on the execution session, reused unedited from run_h20260922_05_salvage.py via screen_lane.candidate_returns_for_offset
combo_rebalance_cost_model: combo_cost_bps * sum(abs(delta sleeve weight)), charged on the session after each month-end rebalance signal, via screen_lane.combine_two_sleeves (ported unedited from run_h20260927_01_sleeve_combination.combine_portfolio)
control_cost_model: the paired vol-matched k*S3+(1-k)*SHY control pays no rebalancing cost (conservative in the control's favor, adverse to the candidate combination), via screen_lane.diversifier_edge_for_offset / combo.control_series
